phases.objective: Repair Migration 1043 post-Apply certification to consume the canonical governed migration readback shape and provide a separately triggered readback-only certificate that can never send or retry Apply.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authorized repository operator certifying an already-applied governed migration
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Static readback-only workflow, certifier, canonical parser, and exact issue-comment trigger
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The repository proves the canonical schema readback shape, exact Apply ledger contract, expected objects, and readiness-view requirements while exposing no governed migration Apply capability or retry path.
steps: Require the exact CERTIFY_1043_SPRINT69_TENANT_MANAGED_EXECUTION_LIFECYCLE_READBACK comment on issue #4449 from an OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR.
Checkout trusted main with contents:read only.
Validate the pinned Migration 1043 blob and checksum and require current Production/runtime exact-SHA parity.
Call governed_migration_schema_readback with the exact migration, checksum, statement count, and expected object names.
Accept only canonical readback.schema.tables rows keyed by TABLE_NAME and require expectations.missing.tables to be an empty array.
Require an exact mode=apply ledger with matching migration, checksum, four statements, preflight pass, zero risks, and no secret evidence.
Read the readiness view through canonical /admin/control tool=db action=run sql in read_only mode only.
Require readiness_status=ready with 3/3 tables and 15/15 binding columns.
Emit sanitized evidence with readback_only=true, apply_sent=false, migration_apply_executed=false, and managed_control_plane_write_executed=false.
assertions: The readback-only workflow contains no APPLY_1043 confirmation, governed_migration_execute call, mode=apply request, execution envelope creation, or apply authorization operation.
The certifier self-test accepts schema.tables[].TABLE_NAME with an empty expectations.missing.tables array and rejects the legacy readback.tables shape.
The Migration 1043 Apply runner uses the same canonical schema.tables[].TABLE_NAME object parser so successful canonical readback cannot false-fail certification.
The only direct database operation in readback certification is tool=db, action=run, read_only=true against the fixed readiness-view SELECT.

No SQL migration execution, second Apply attempt, authorization bootstrap, managed control-plane write, provider call, credential payload access, external business write, deployment, Production ref mutation, or secret evidence is permitted by this contract.
